sections.heading: Stop guessing about your hormones. Get answers from home!
sections.body: Feeling like something is off even though you’ve been told everything looks “normal”? The RHM At-Home Hormone Testing Kit gives you access to key labs without waiting for someone else to decide it’s time to look deeper. Your symptoms are information. Let’s find out what they’re telling us.

sections.label: What’s inside?
sections.heading: Get a clearer picture of your health with our easy-to-use $227 at-home test kit.
sections.body: Your test measures these key health and hormone markers:

cards.small: Helps assess kidney function and overall kidney health.
Estimates how well your kidneys are filtering your blood.
Measures the percentage of your blood made up of red blood cells.
Measures the oxygen-carrying protein in your red blood cells.
A marker used to assess liver and bile duct health.
Measures a key hormone involved in reproductive, sexual, bone, and overall health in both women and men.
Measures total testosterone in the blood, an important hormone involved in energy, muscle mass, sexual health, and overall well-being.
Measures a key hormone involved in menstrual cycle regulation and reproductive health.
A marker used to evaluate prostate health.

sections.heading: Your Results Are Just the Beginning.
sections.body: Your labs can reveal patterns that may be contributing to how you feel—but identifying the problem is only the first step.

sections.heading: How it works:
told: Order Your Kit: Purchase your $227 at-home testing kit.
Complete Your Testing: Follow the simple instructions to complete your lab testing.
Get Real Data: Your sample is processed and your results give us objective information about what may be happening beneath your symptoms.
Know What to Do Next: Use your results to make a more informed decision about your health and whether additional evaluation or treatment makes sense.
